user.title: Better Assistant
user.description: Optional: paste a Brave Search API key to let the assistant look things up on the web. Leave it empty to use only the local answers (spelling, maths, units, dates, world clock); you can add a key later with Reconfigure. Checking the key uses 1 search from your Brave credit.

reconfigure.title: Change API key
reconfigure.description: Enter a new key, or leave it empty to turn web search off. Checking a new key uses 1 search from your Brave credit.

security.title: Security
security.description: Passphrase: {passphrase_state}. With a passphrase, opening locks, garage doors and gates (the ones listed under Guest mode) and ending guest mode by voice need it: "open the garage door, passphrase followed by your words", or just "open the garage door" on a voice speaker and answer the question. Those doors are hidden from Home Assistant's own voice commands while this is on. Without a passphrase, anyone who can talk to a speaker can open them.

data.passphrase: New passphrase (leave empty to keep the current one)
data.require_doors: Require passphrase to open locks and doors by voice
data.require_guest: Require passphrase to end guest mode by voice
data.owner: Tell this person's phone about passphrase use

data_description.passphrase: Never shown, logged or spoken. Case, spaces and punctuation don't matter.
data_description.owner: A notification on every correct and wrong passphrase.

voice_training.title: Voice training (experimental)
voice_training.description:
Records labelled voice clips for a later voice-match test. Nothing recognises voices yet, and nothing is recorded while this is off. Clips stay on this machine in {folder}. Only record people who agree to it.

To train, say "train my voice" or "train Rob's voice" on a voice speaker and say 8 phrases to the speaker (shown on your phone, or read out). Recordings only work when the voice assistant's speech-to-text is Better Assistant speech-to-text (tick it below).

Saved so far: {counts}.

data.voice_record_test: Also record everyday requests for voice-match testing
data.voice_stt_engine: Speech-to-text engine to pass audio to
data.pipelines: Voice assistants that use Better Assistant speech-to-text
data.voice_training_phone: Show the phrases on my phone (the speaker stays silent)

data_description.voice_record_test: Every request heard on a speaker is saved as a "test" clip, labelled with the only person in the house or "unknown".
data_description.voice_stt_engine: Empty: Home Assistant Cloud if you have it, else Whisper (Wyoming), else the first one found.
data_description.pipelines: Ticked ones switch their speech-to-text to Better Assistant speech-to-text; unticking (or turning voice training off) switches them back.
data_description.delete_recordings: Removes every clip and its notes from the folder above.
data_description.voice_training_phone: Uses the Home Assistant app on the phone linked to the person being trained. Without one, the speaker reads the phrases out.

progress.voice_install: Installing and starting the speech add-ons. This can take several minutes on the first run while Whisper downloads its model.
